blocks.h2: Toilet Problems We Fix in Hinsdale

tiles.body: A clog in the bowl or further down the line.
A worn flapper or fill valve.
A failed wax ring or a loose toilet.

blocks.intro: Hinsdale homes often have several bathrooms, and some have toilets over finished ceilings.

items.body: An upstairs overflow can reach the ceiling below fast. Shut the valve behind the toilet and call us.
Cast iron flanges can corrode, letting the toilet rock and the seal fail.
Wall-hung, comfort-height and bidet toilets need careful installation.
A powder room toilet that clogs during a party is a common call. Newer high-performance toilets clear far better than early low-flow models.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton
blocks.intro: We'll tell you whether to repair or replace.

steps.body: Tank, bowl, seal, flange and drain.
For the repair or a new toilet.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Toilet Work
blocks.body: Small parts are quick. Smart toilets, wall-hung models and bidet seats with power take more time. A damaged flange adds work. We look first and quote a flat price.

items.q: What should I do if my toilet overflows?
items.preview: Close the shutoff valve behind it.
items.answer: Turn the shutoff valve behind the toilet clockwise to stop the water. Then call us. If water reached a ceiling below, turn off power to any fixtures there.

items.q: Do you clean up after a toilet overflow?
items.preview: We fix the toilet. A restoration company handles major water damage.
items.answer: We clear the clog and fix the toilet. For water damage to floors or ceilings, a restoration company is the right call.

items.q: Why does my toilet keep running?
items.preview: Usually the flapper or fill valve.
items.answer: Usually a worn flapper or a fill valve that won't shut off. Both are simple repairs.

items.q: Can you install a wall-hung toilet?
items.answer: Yes. Wall-hung toilets need an in-wall carrier and tank, which we install as part of a remodel.

items.q: Can you install a wall-hung toilet?
items.answer: Yes, usually during a remodel, since the carrier goes inside the wall.

items.q: How much does toilet repair cost in Hinsdale?
items.preview: It depends on the problem. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what's wrong and whether you're repairing or replacing. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
